comments.text: Reopened again after full contract audit. Concrete counterexamples: TermDag encodes TermId as arena index+1, violating the stable-identity invariant that TermId is not an arena handle and making IDs insertion-order dependent; public insert_node accepts unvalidated child IDs, permitting a first node to reference TermId(1) (itself), after which depth()/to_expr recurse without a cycle guard. bindings.rs defines no binder node, alpha_equivalent never adds entries to either bound-variable map, and capture_avoiding_subs is ordinary replacement, so binder/alpha/capture semantics are not implemented.
